Hue now matches the official photos: back B/R 1.22 (p8) against 1.21-1.25 (py_37301), and rectangular light/dark cell patches are present. New problems, logged as issue 1: too much contrast, too crisp, and darker than the shell.

calibration.issue: w4a LOW: wing flecks are white on neutral and cold
calibration.status: fixed (superseded): sakura chips on blue-grey. The chip scale matches py_37305 (9-16 mm). The shape is still too round and regular (issue 7).

calibration.issue: w4a LOW: placards blank, flap is a flat board
calibration.status: not fixed: the placards are still blank white quads (st/p2, py_b/r2), and the flap is still a rigid board with relative contrast 0.18 against 0.87 in py_37305.

calibration.issue: w4b MED: headrest wings show over the shell arch from behind
calibration.status: not fixed / slight regression: the wing still pokes outside the shell silhouette at the top inboard corner (py_b/r1top, x 500-540). The 28 deg wings reach about |x| 0.253 at y 0.85-0.895, but the shell is only 0.2375 at 0.925 and 0.205 at 0.94.

calibration.issue: w4b MED: grey stub (coat hook) sticking out of the shell side
calibration.status: fixed: the coat hook is gone. The root bullet and button now read as the real gooseneck root (san_26 left).

calibration.issue: w4b MED: fabric motif too uniform
calibration.status: superseded by the official dash grid (see issue 1).

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: literature-pocket mesh too tall
calibration.status: changed but wrong order: the mesh is now a shallow 0.30 x 0.065 window, but the proud tray lip sits at the TOP, just under the placards. In san_26, san_20 and b_gf_a380_0537 the curved rigid lip is at the BOTTOM of the pocket, with the mesh band under and behind it (issue 2).

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: leg struts too warm
calibration.status: mostly fixed: #bab7ae renders about neutral-warm silver (py_b/r3 #a7a39c-#c2c0bb). The footrest arm still reads slightly cream in the studio.

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: bottle-bin cups read as closed lids
calibration.status: not fixed: the cup 'floors' (y 0.4405, 4 mm) sit ON the bin top (0.44), so from above they are two flat grey squares (py_b/r3). san_20, san_17 and b_gf_a380_0588 show open brushed wells about 8 cm deep.

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: wings darker than the back and separate
calibration.status: fixed: the wing tone is about the back's (p4 wing L 120 against back 97-113), and the ANA layout has separate wings beside the flap, which matches py_37305.

details.detail: Overall massing against py_37301, py_37302 and py_37303: the 2-4-2 blocks, bolstered back, flap and wings, deep grey flanks, 0.135 console, slim window armrest, aisle shroud with cap, skirt, roller and leg rest all read as the ZIM seat (st/p3, p8, q14). Proportions check out: flap h/w 0.95 (py_37302 fg 1.0); flap/headrest width 0.60 (st/p4) against 0.70 (py_37305); shell/wall luminance 0.62 (q14) against 0.51-0.77 (py_37303, py_37301).

Back fabric (dash grid). The scale is right: about 8 mm row pitch and 13 mm dashes in py_b/r4 against 7 mm / 9-14 mm in py_37305 (875 px/m from the 0.28 m flap). The hue is right: B/R 1.22 against 1.21-1.25. But the contrast is about 1.3-1.6x too high: (p90-p10)/p50 is 0.59-0.65 in p8 against 0.39-0.51 in py_37301 from the same camera. The dashes are crisp, uniform, near-white bars about 0.42 of the row pitch, where the real ones are thin, soft and of varying brightness, about 0.3 of the pitch. At q13 distance this reads as a bold white 'LED/barcode' pattern; py_37302 at the same distance reads as a fine light tweed. The fabric is also too dark against the shell: fabric/shell luminance is 0.95 (q14 114/119) and about 1.07 (q13), against 1.54 (py_37303 160/104) and about 1.2 (py_37301). In every official photo the seat fabric is clearly LIGHTER than the grey plastics.

Headrest wings: the size (0.21 tall), position beside the flap and the inward cant read like py_37305 and py_37302. The sakura chips are the right size (9-16 mm) but are rounded ovals evenly spaced. The real ones are irregular petals and flakes of mixed size, denser, with some 5-petal shapes.

Navy flap: the colour is fine (B/R 2.1 against 1.57-2.44 in the official set), and the size and hem are right. It is a perfectly flat, uniformly lit board. py_37305 shows a soft leatherette with a fold over the top, a soft dent and draped lower corners.

Gooseneck: the head shape (38 x 115 mm brushed cylinder, side lens, 50 deg) matches py_37305 and b_gf_a380_0492. In its stowed default position the head sits about 0.20 m forward of the back at shoulder height. So in q13 the black hoses cross diagonally in front of the neighbouring headrests and flaps (q13 100-190 x 330-460, 270-300 x 230-300), which is the most eye-catching non-fabric mismatch. In py_37301 and py_37303 the stowed hose runs down beside the shell's front edge and the head hangs about 5-8 cm in front of it.

Seatback screen and placards: the bezel size and shell rim are right (py_37304, san_26). The screen is set nearly flush with a thin dark gap, where py_37304 shows a wider (about 2.5-3 cm) dark recessed frame. The placards are blank white.

Literature pocket: the order is inverted. The model has a proud tray lip right under the placards (bezel bottom +0.07), then a flat panel with a black slot. The real one (san_26, at 1065 px/m from the 0.263 bezel) has an elastic upper pocket from +0.04, a curved rigid grey lip about 0.40 wide and 5 cm proud at +0.20, a black mesh band under and behind the lip, and the pocket bottom at +0.24.

Console front: the pockets, blue triangles, twin sockets and red tab are in the right order and size (st/p5, p8 against py_37301 and py_37306). The pocket fronts are proud plates under a 16 mm black slot. The real console face is bluer than the fabric (B/R 1.59 against fabric 1.20 in py_37301), while the model's is only marginally bluer (1.28 against 1.22).

Console lid, nose and side plaques: the lid groove, silver plaque, buttons and handset dock match py_37303. The light-grey nose block with two cup discs reads as a separate box sitting on the lid (st/p8 275-335 x 250-290). In py_37303 the cups are recessed into a flush rounded nose.
Window-end armrest: a slim dark cantilevered arm with a light top edge and a white seat-letter square, as in py_37301 and py_37302.

Aisle shroud: the cap that rounds over the front, the lighter recessed panel, the silver strip and the handle recess match py_37303 and san_13. The real silver strip sweeps up in a curve at the front; the model's is straight.
Leg rest, skirt and fluted roller: right against py_37301.
Footrest: the dark ribbed pads with silver caps and the hub match san_20. In san_20 and b_gf_a380_0537 it hangs on straight vertical silver hangers; the model's single arm is tilted 32 deg.
Bottle bin: the size, colour and placard are right. The cups render as two flat closed lids (see calibration).

issues.issue: Back fabric is too contrasty, crisp and dark: it reads as a bold white barcode instead of ANA's fine light tweed
issues.evidence: Relative contrast (p90-p10)/p50 is 0.59-0.65 (st/p8) against 0.39-0.51 (py_37301, same camera). Fabric/shell luminance is 0.95-1.07 (q14, q13) against 1.2-1.54 (py_37301, py_37303). See py_b/cmp1 and py_b/r4.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: (1) cut the dash amplitude by about 35 % (target relative contrast 0.45); (2) thin each dash to about 0.30 of the row pitch (from about 0.42) and soften its edges with a 1 px blur at tile resolution; (3) randomise each dash's brightness ±25 % and its length ±30 % so the rows stop reading as LED bars. Keep the rectangular cell patches but at about half their current amplitude. Then in 09_seats.js raise SEATMAT.pyFabric photoBase '#848896' -> about '#9ca0ae' (about +18 % luminance, same B/R 1.12), so fabric/shell is about 1.3 in q14.

issues.issue: Literature pocket inverted: the proud lip is at the top, under the placards
issues.evidence: st/p6 and py_b/r2 against san_26, san_20 and b_gf_a380_0537: the real curved rigid lip is about 0.20 below the bezel bottom, with mesh under it.
issues.fix: 09b_py.js pocket block (py0 = 0.325): move the tray lip gRBox(0.44,0.045,0.05) from on(0.557) to on(0.425, 0.03) and make it gRBox(0.40,0.05,0.055,0.02) so its front is curved and proud. Put the mesh gBox(0.34,0.035,0.003) at on(0.395,0.022), under and behind the lip. Replace the flat panel with a recessed elastic-pocket panel gRBox(0.36,0.13,0.01) at on(0.515,0.004), and drop the black slot at 0.445 and the 'mouth shadow' at 0.541 (keep only a thin dark mouth line at 0.578).

issues.issue: Stowed gooseneck hangs about 20 cm forward, so the black hoses cross in front of the neighbouring headrests
issues.evidence: q13 (100-190 x 330-460 and 270-300 x 230-300) against py_37301, py_37302 and py_37303, where the stowed head hangs just in front of the shell edge beside the wing.
issues.fix: 09b_py.js gooseneck: tube points -> P(0.262,0.84,zr(0.84)-0.065), P(0.262,0.80,-0.03), P(0.255,0.70,-0.07), P(0.245,0.64,-0.085); head hd = trs(sd*0.243, 0.60, -0.10, 0, 35*DEG). issues.fix: 09b_py.js ds: [0.925,0.065,0.475] -> [0.925,0.07,0.51] and [0.94,0.04,0.41] -> [0.94,0.045,0.47], or move the wing WX x from 0.175 to 0.165 and cut its cant from 28 to 24 deg. Check from the py_b/r1 camera (az 0.35, el 0.45, dist 2.0).

09b_py.js: move the cup floors from y 0.4405 to 0.37 (inside the bin). Add a darker top ring of four thin pyBin walls per cup (0.004 thick, 0.07 tall, top at 0.442), and make the bin body top a 0.004 rim frame instead of a solid top. Or simplest: lower the bin box to h 0.36 (centre 0.18) and build the cup walls 0.36-0.44.

issues.issue: Flap is a rigid flat board
issues.evidence: Relative contrast 0.18 (st/p4) against 0.87 (py_37305: fold highlight, soft dent, draped corners).
issues.fix: Replace the gRBox(0.28,0.265,0.008) flap with a 6x6 gLoft/gGrid whose bottom corners curl back 6-8 mm and whose centre bulges 4 mm forward over y 0.70-0.85. Add a 1.5 cm rounded fold at the top edge (the current 0.07-deep top piece with r 0.03).

issues.issue: Wing chips are round evenly spaced ovals
issues.evidence: st/p4 against py_37305: irregular petals and flakes of mixed size, about 1.5x denser.
issues.fix: synth confetti: draw 5-petal and 2-3-lobe flake polygons at 4-16 mm, 1.5x the count, with random rotation, and 20 % small 2-3 mm specks.

issues.issue: Placards blank; screen recess too thin
issues.evidence: st/p2 and py_b/r2 against py_37304 and san_26.
issues.fix: Atlas: two placard tiles with 2 JP + 2 EN text lines (grey on white). Screen: widen the black surround gRBox(0.385,0.272) to (0.405,0.29) and set it 6 mm deeper.

issues.issue: Footrest arm tilted; console nose reads as a separate box
issues.evidence: py_b/r3 against san_20; st/p8 against py_37303.
issues.fix: Footrest arm: rotation 32 -> 0 deg (vertical), plus a second straight hanger at x0-0.04. Console nose: lower it to y 0.635 with h 0.04, so its top is flush with the lid top (0.665), and recess the cup discs 8 mm.

issues.issue: (Not PY: lighting) Sharp bright quadrilateral sun patch on the window-seat back
issues.fix: Lighting/integration: soften the window sun LUT footprint on the seats.

questions: The official py_37302 foreground seat shows white petal flecks on the upper back as well, not only on the wings, while py_37301 and py_37305 show the dash grid there. Should the area just under the headrest stay dash grid (current) or use the petal fabric?

Stowed gooseneck: should the model show the default stowed pose (head hanging just in front of the shell, as in py_37301 and py_37303) rather than py_37305's posed, pulled-out lights? The rater recommends the stowed pose.
